mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_role (tenant_id, user_id, role_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{roleId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.is_super_role = '1' AND r.status = '0'
